shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; head -c 600 package-lock.json; git log --stat | head -20

for f in index.html src/*.ts* vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; ls __agent_eval__ node_modules | head -60; ls node_modules | grep -i -E "grid|dnd|layout|gravity|chart"; D=/tmp/claude-1000/bundled-skills/2.1.318/d03bc84f7603755c4556ef946b722d16/dataviz; ls $D $D/references
ls node_modules/@gravity-ui node_modules/@hello-pangea; D=/tmp/claude-1000/bundled-skills/2.1.318/d03bc84f7603755c4556ef946b722d16/dataviz/references; cat $D/palette.md $D/choosing-a-form.md
D=/tmp/claude-1000/bundled-skills/2.1.318/d03bc84f7603755c4556ef946b722d16/dataviz; cat $D/references/marks-and-anatomy.md $D/references/interaction.md $D/references/anti-patterns.md

D=/tmp/claude-1000/bundled-skills/2.1.318/d03bc84f7603755c4556ef946b722d16/dataviz; node $D/scripts/validate_palette.js "#2a78d6,#eb6834,#1baf7a,#eda100,#e87ba4" --mode light 2>&1 | tail -30; node $D/scripts/validate_palette.js "#3987e5,#d95926,#199e70,#c98500,#d55181" --mode dark 2>&1 | tail -30; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; grep -o "export {[^}]*}" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts | head -0; for n in Plus Pencil Xmark Check TrashBin ArrowRotateLeft Grip GripVertical Table ChartLine ArrowsOppositeToDotsH ArrowUp ArrowDown; do ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/svgo/$n.svg >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "icon $n ok" || echo "icon $n MISSING"; done; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && for n in Plus Pencil Xmark Check TrashBin ArrowRotateLeft Bars Table ChartLine ArrowUp ArrowDown CircleCheck TriangleExclamation CircleXmark ArrowsExpandUpRightAndDownLeft; do ls icons/$n.js >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "ok $n" || echo "MISSING $n"; done; cat icons/package.json | grep -E '"(version|exports)"' ; grep -E '"version"' uikit/package.json; ls uikit/build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons && for n in ListUl LayoutCells Layout ChartColumn ChartBar Grip Move ArrowsRotateRight Funnel Tag; do ls $n.js >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "ok $n" || echo "MISSING $n"; done; grep -n "SegmentedRadioGroup" ../uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -30

mkdir -p /home/sandbox/workspace/src/dashboard/widgets /home/sandbox/workspace/src/dashboard/viz && cd /home/sandbox/workspace && grep -rn "g-root_theme\|document.body\|classList" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider/*.js | head; sed -n 1,60p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/types.d.ts
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30 && npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -6

rm -rf dist; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome playwright 2>&1 | head; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules | grep -i -E "playwright|puppeteer"; npm ls -g --depth=0 2>/dev/null | head
cd /tmp && timeout 20 npm view playwright version 2>&1 | tail -3
mkdir -p /tmp/pw && cd /tmp/pw && npm init -y >/dev/null && timeout 300 npm i playwright >/dev/null 2>&1; timeout 400 npx playwright install chromium 2>&1 | tail -5
id -u; sudo -n true 2>&1 | head -1; ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1248/chrome-headless-shell-linux-arm64/chrome-headless-shell 2>/dev/null | grep "not found" | head -20
mkdir -p /tmp/debs && cd /tmp/debs && cat /etc/os-release | head -2; timeout 60 apt-get download libglib2.0-0 2>&1 | tail -3; ls

cd /tmp/debs && pkgs="libglib2.0-0 libnspr4 libnss3 libatk1.0-0 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libdbus-1-3 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libgbm1 libxkbcommon0 libasound2 libatspi2.0-0 libx11-6 libxcb1 libxext6 libcups2 libpango-1.0-0 libcairo2 libdrm2 libwayland-server0 libffi8 libpcre2-8-0 libxau6 libxdmcp6 libxi6 libxcursor1 libxrender1 libexpat1 libpng16-16 libfontconfig1 libfreetype6 libpixman-1-0 libxcb-render0 libxcb-shm0 libfribidi0 libharfbuzz0b libthai0 libdatrie1 libgraphite2-3 libmount1 libblkid1 libselinux1 libsystemd0 libavahi-client3 libavahi-common3 libgnutls30 libbsd0 libmd0 libxkbcommon0 libxml2 libicu72 libdrm-common"; for p in $pkgs; do timeout 60 apt-get download $p >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "skip $p"; done; mkdir -p /tmp/syslibs && for d in *.deb; do dpkg-deb -x $d /tmp/syslibs; done; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/syslibs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/syslibs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu; ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1248/chrome-headless-shell-linux-arm64/chrome-headless-shell | grep "not found"

export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/syslibs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/syslibs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:5199/; cd /tmp/pw && node shot.mjs 2>&1 | tail -15

export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/syslibs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/syslibs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu; cd /tmp/pw && DEBUG=pw:browser node t.mjs 2>&1 | grep -v "^\s*$" | grep -i -E "err|fatal|abort|signal|cannot|fail|exit" | head -15

export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/syslibs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/syslibs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu; cd /tmp/pw && sed -i "s/chromium.launch()/chromium.launch({ args: ['--no-sandbox','--disable-gpu','--single-process','--no-zygote'] })/" shot.mjs && node shot.mjs 2>&1 | tail -12; ls /tmp/pw/*.png
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/syslibs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/syslibs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu; cd /tmp/pw && DEBUG=pw:browser node t.mjs 2>&1 | grep -v dbus | tail -12 | cut -c1-300

export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/syslibs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/syslibs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu; cd /tmp/pw && sed -i "s#await p.route('\*\*/src/App.tsx'.*#await p.route(/fonts\\\\.css/, r => r.fulfill({ contentType: 'text/css', body: '' }));#" t4.mjs && grep -n route t4.mjs && node t4.mjs 2>&1 | tail -3

export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/syslibs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/syslibs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu; cd /tmp/pw && sed -i "s#^await p.goto('http://127.0.0.1:5199/');#await p.route(/fonts\\\\.css/, r => r.fulfill({ contentType: 'text/css', body: '' }));\nawait p.goto('http://127.0.0.1:5199/');#" shot.mjs && node shot.mjs 2>&1 | tail -12; ls /tmp/pw/*.png

export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/syslibs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/syslibs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu; cd /tmp/pw && for f in t5.mjs shot.mjs; do sed -i "s#await p.route(/fonts\\\\.css/, r => r.fulfill({ contentType: 'text/css', body: '' }));#await p.route(/fonts\\\\.css/, r => r.fulfill(r.request().url().includes('import') ? { contentType: 'text/javascript', body: 'export default \"\"' } : { contentType: 'text/css', body: '' }));#" $f; done; grep -c "includes('import')" shot.mjs; node shot.mjs 2>&1 | tail -12; ls /tmp/pw/*.png
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/syslibs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/syslibs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu; cd /tmp/pw && node t5.mjs 2>&1 | tail -15

export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/syslibs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/syslibs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu; cd /tmp/pw && for f in t5.mjs shot.mjs; do sed -i "s#r.request().url().includes('import')#r.request().resourceType() === 'script'#" $f; done; node t5.mjs 2>&1 | tail -6 | cut -c1-300; node shot.mjs 2>&1 | tail -8; ls /tmp/pw/*.png

cd /tmp/debs && apt-get download fonts-dejavu-core >/dev/null 2>&1; dpkg-deb -x fonts-dejavu-core*.deb /tmp/syslibs; ls /tmp/syslibs/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu | head -3; cat > /tmp/fonts.conf <<'EOF'
<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE fontconfig SYSTEM "fonts.dtd"><fontconfig><dir>/tmp/syslibs/usr/share/fonts</dir><cachedir>/tmp/fccache</cachedir>
<alias><family>sans-serif</family><prefer><family>DejaVu Sans</family></prefer></alias>
<alias><family>system-ui</family><prefer><family>DejaVu Sans</family></prefer></alias></fontconfig>
EOF
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/syslibs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/syslibs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/fonts.conf; cd /tmp/pw && node shot.mjs 2>&1 | tail -4
pkill -f "vite --port 5199"; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -4; npx vitest run 2>&1 | grep -E "Tests|passed|failed"; rm -rf dist; git status --short
for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do if tr '\0' ' ' < $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null | grep -q "vite --port 5199"; then kill ${p#/proc/} 2>/dev/null && echo "stopped ${p#/proc/}"; fi; done
